scope: Persisted certificate integrity and claimed bounds; not an independent mathematical audit

local_arithmetic_contract.exp:
Return the value of the (natural) exponential function e**x.

The function always uses the ROUND_HALF_EVEN mode and the result is
correctly rounded.
local_arithmetic_contract.next_minus: Returns the largest representable number smaller than itself.
local_arithmetic_contract.next_plus: Returns the smallest representable number larger than itself.
